faq.findQ: How do I find a place?
faq.findA: Open Search, pick a city or campus, and filter by rooms, budget, and gender. Save apartments you like so you can compare them later.
faq.bookA: Open a listing, tap Book, choose dates and who will live there, then send the request. The owner accepts or declines. A booking in the app is a request, not a signed lease.
faq.verifyQ: Why do I need ID and a university card?
faq.verifyA: Owners need to know who is moving in. Upload your national ID and, if you are a student, your university card. You cannot book until these are done.
faq.payA: Payments in this version are simulated. Visa / pay now does not charge a real card. Cash is settled with the owner outside the app.
faq.moveInQ: What happens after the owner accepts?
faq.moveInA: The stay is confirmed. House rules and how to arrive show on the booking, or the owner can send them in chat. When the stay ends, write a 1–5 star review so the next student knows what to expect.
faq.ownersQ: I own an apartment. How do I list it?
faq.ownersA: Owner accounts are created by the admin. After approval you add photos and details, wait for listing approval, then manage booking requests from Bookings.
faq.renterQ: I am not a student. Can I still rent?
faq.renterA: Yes. Create a renter account with any email. You can search by city, book, and message owners. University card is not required.
faq.blocksA: Open the chat, tap the person, then Block. They cannot message you. Manage blocked people from Profile → Security.
faq.reportsQ: How do I report a problem?
faq.reportsA: Open the menu, tap Report, and tell us what happened. Safety reports go to trust and safety. You can also report from a chat.

menu.howBody:
Matra7 is a student housing marketplace for Palestine.

Students: sign up with a university email (.edu or .edu.ps), search near your campus, save listings, book, and chat with the owner.

Looking to rent: workers, families, and anyone else can create a renter account with any email, then search, book, and message owners.

Apartment owners: accounts are created by the admin only. After approval you can add listings and manage bookings.

Payments in this soft launch are simulated. Cash means you settle with the owner offline. Visa marks the request as paid in the app for demo — no real card is charged.
menu.privacyBody:
This policy (version 1) explains how Matra7 uses your data.

We collect what we need to run the marketplace: name, email, phone, WhatsApp, city, university, profile photo, home address, national ID number and card images (for safety review), emergency contact if you share it, listing details, bookings, chat text/photos/voice, search-alert preferences, device session info, an optional last-seen IP, and an optional push-notification token.

Data is stored on our servers (Supabase). We do not sell your data. Card payments in this version are simulated; we do not process real card numbers.

We use the data to operate your account, show relevant housing, handle bookings, run in-app chat, send optional notifications, review IDs, moderate listings, and — only if you leave analytics on — count anonymous in-app events such as search opens.

You can export or delete your account from Profile → Security. To ask a privacy question, email {{email}}.

Last updated: September 2026.
menu.termsBody:
By using the app you agree to these terms (version 1).

The app is a marketplace that connects people looking for housing with apartment owners in Palestine, with students as the main audience. A booking in the app is a request to the owner; it is not by itself a legal lease, and we are not a party to any rent contract you later sign.

Students must use a valid university email. Renters (workers, families, and others) may use any valid email. Owner accounts are created by the admin. Listings must be truthful. We may hide, reject, or remove listings and suspend accounts that break the rules or put others at risk.

National ID and student-card images are for verification. Owners see ID photos after a stay is confirmed. Chat is private to the two sides of a listing conversation.

Payments are simulated in this version. No real card is charged.

Use the app in good faith. Do not harass, spam, or impersonate other users. Contact {{email}} for support or close your account from Profile → Security.

Last updated: September 2026.

profile.deleteAccountBodyOwner: Your login, listings, bookings, and chats are removed. You cannot undo this.
profile.deleteAccountFailed: Could not delete the account. Try again, or email us.
profile.deleteAccountAgainBody: This is the last step. The account and its data are removed and cannot be restored.
profile.devicesIntro: Devices that recently used your account in this app. Sign out others if something looks unfamiliar.
profile.devicesEmpty: No other device activity recorded yet. Open the app on another device to see it here.
profile.signOutOthersHint: Keeps this phone signed in and signs out every other session.
profile.signOutOthersBody: You stay signed in here. Other phones and browsers will need to log in again.
profile.signOutOthersFailed: Could not sign out other devices. Try again.
profile.pickAddressHelp: The map opens on your location. Drag the pin if needed, then confirm.
profile.pickAddressEmpty: Move the pin to see the address
profile.locationPermission: Allow location access so the map can show where you are.
profile.locationFailed: Could not find your location. Check GPS is on, then try again or move the pin.
profile.locationServicesOff: Turn on location services, then try Use my location again.
profile.homeAddressPick: Tap to pick on Google Maps
profile.homeAddressTrustHint: For verification and emergency only. Owners do not see this address.
profile.homeAddressMapInvalid: Move the pin until a full street address appears, then confirm.
profile.homeAddressHint: Street, building, city — real address, not random letters.
profile.nationalIdHint: 9 digits with a valid check digit (Palestinian or Israeli ID)
profile.nationalIdInvalid: That ID number fails the check digit. Re-check the 9 digits on your card.
profile.nationalIdOk: ID number check digit looks valid
profile.downloadMyDataHint: Export a CSV of your account data, or a summary image you can save.
profile.exportFailed: Could not prepare the export. Try again.
profile.nationalCardHint: Clear photo of the front of your ID, for legal agreements.
profile.universityCardHint: Clear photo of your student card so the owner can check it.
profile.replaceCardHint: This card is expired or was rejected. Upload a new photo.
profile.confirmIdBody: Owners and admins can open this photo when you book.
profile.idUploadFailed: Could not upload the card photo. Try another image under 5 MB.
profile.idUploadDbMissing: Run student-trust.sql and id-verification.sql in the Supabase SQL editor once, then try again.
profile.trustHint: Needed to book. An admin checks the photos. Owners see a summary first; they can open the cards after you book.
profile.trustAudience: An admin checks the card photos. The preview in Your details is what owners see first — not the scans.
profile.idVerifiedHint: An admin checked your ID cards. Owners see a verified badge on your booking.
profile.idPendingHint: Your cards are uploaded. An admin will check them soon. You can still book.
profile.homeAddressInvalid: Enter a real home address (at least 12 characters, with letters).
profile.emergencyNameHint: Parent, sibling, or a person you trust.
profile.emergencyNameInvalid: Enter a real first and last name for your emergency contact.
profile.bioHintOwner: Short intro for students and renters (20–400 characters). Optional.
profile.bioInvalid: About me must be empty or 20–400 characters.
profile.idExpiryHint: Add the expiry date printed on your ID card.
profile.idExpiryInvalid: ID expiry is missing or expired — use a valid date from your card.
profile.idExpiresSoon: ID expires within 60 days — renew and re-upload after renewal.
profile.idExpired: ID is expired — upload a renewed card.
profile.idConsent: I agree that Matra7 stores my national ID number and card photo for booking verification.
profile.idConsentHint: Only you, admins, and landlords with a booking on you can open the card. We keep it while your account is active.
profile.idConsentRequired: Accept the ID storage notice before uploading cards.
profile.recoveryHint: Used if you lose access to your university email after graduating.
profile.recoveryEmailInvalid: Enter a valid backup email, or leave it empty.
profile.recoveryPhoneInvalid: Enter a valid backup mobile number (like 059…), or leave it empty.
profile.recoveryEmailSame: Backup email must be different from your login email.
profile.blockedHint: Blocked people cannot message you. Unblock anytime.
profile.blockBody: You will not be able to message {{name}}. You can unblock later in Security.
profile.unblockBody: They will be able to message you again.
profile.idRejectedHint: Upload clearer ID photos, then wait for review again.
profile.emergencyHint: Someone we or the owner can call if something happens.
profile.emergencySamePhone: Use a different number than your own phone.
profile.phoneConfirmHint: Free check: we open WhatsApp on this number. If the chat opens, you control it.
profile.phoneConfirmBody: If WhatsApp opened on this number, tap confirm. This is a free check, not a paid SMS code.
profile.idCardsHint: Use these only to check who is booking.
profile.deviceIpHint: Saved automatically when you save your profile. You do not type this.
profile.privacyIntro: Talk with the owner in app chat so the thread stays on record. You can choose when they may see your phone to call. Admins can still review for safety.
profile.privacyIntroOwner: Students message you in app chat so the thread stays on record. You can choose when they may see your phone to call.
profile.privacyChatHint: WhatsApp between students and owners is off. Use in-app chat.
profile.shareEmergencyHint: Owners see the emergency name and phone on your booking.
profile.shareEmergencyOwnerHint: Confirmed tenants see your emergency name and phone.
profile.hideLastSeenHint: Hides the network address from owners. Applies as soon as you toggle.
profile.hideSavedCountHint: Hides the number next to Saved in the menu and on the profile tab. Applies as soon as you toggle.
profile.prefsIntro: Search uses budget, house type, people (enough rooms), and move-in (hides places taken then). Lease length is used when you book.
profile.prefsMoveInHint: Search hides apartments that are taken on this date.
profile.prefsOccupantsHint: Three or more people prefers listings with enough rooms (two people can share one).
profile.prefsLeaseHint: Used when you book. Search does not filter by lease length.
profile.budgetInvalid: Enter a valid monthly budget, or leave it empty.
profile.occupantsInvalid: Pick 1 to 4 people, or clear the choice.
profile.notifyMasterHint: One place for alerts on this phone: permission, master switch, then booking, chat, listings, and reviews.
profile.notifyMasterSwitch: Master switch. Off silences all push on this device.
profile.notifyOsDenied: Notifications are blocked in phone settings.
profile.notifyOsAsk: We’ll ask for permission when you turn the master switch on.
profile.notifyBookingHint: Approved, rejected, and new booking requests.
profile.notifyChatHint: When someone sends you a message.
profile.notifyListingHint: When an admin approves or declines your apartment.
profile.notifySearchHint: Same as the bell on Search. We notify you when new apartments match those filters.
profile.notifyReviewHint: Reminders to review a stay before booking again.
profile.analyticsConsentHint: Lets us count things like search opens. Turn off to stop sending those events.
profile.keepSignedInHint: Skips the idle and background sign-out on this device.
profile.reportsIntro: File a safety or tech issue here. You can track status in this list.
profile.reportSent: Report saved. Our team can see it in the app.
profile.reportFailed: Could not save the report. Try again.
profile.reportBodyShort: Write at least a short sentence about what happened.
profile.settingsSaveFailed: Could not save settings. Try again.

review.title: Stay reviews
review.empty: No reviews yet. The first person who stays here can write one.
review.formHint: 1 to 5 stars, plus what to improve. Other guests will see this.
review.noteHint: At least {{min}} characters. Be specific so the next guest knows what to expect.
review.postedBody: Guests will see it on the apartment page under Reviews. You can also find it on this booking.
review.whereHint: Write reviews here after a stay. They show on the apartment page for other guests.
review.invalid: Pick 1 to 5 stars and write a short note.
review.failed: Could not save the review. Try again.
review.neededBody: Write a review for a place you already stayed before you book another apartment.
review.nudgeInApp: You have {{count}} stay(s) ready for a review.
review.reportDetails: Why is this review a problem?
review.reportShort: Write a bit more detail (at least 8 characters).
review.reportFailed: Could not send the report. Try again.
review.replyHint: Students will see this under the review.
review.replyFailed: Could not post the reply. Run product-ops.sql if needed.

limits.generic: You’re doing that too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
limits.report: Wait a minute before sending another report.
limits.message: Slow down a bit between messages.
limits.booking: Wait half a minute before placing another booking request.

onboarding.studentStepPrefs: Set budget and stay preferences in Settings
onboarding.studentStepSearch: Search near campus anytime — ID is only required to book or message.
onboarding.renterHint: Workers, families, and anyone renting — by city, not campus.
onboarding.renterStepProfile: Add your details. Finish Trust (ID) when you want to book or chat.
onboarding.renterStepPrefs: Set budget and stay preferences in Settings
onboarding.renterStepSearch: Search by city anytime — ID is only required to book or message.
onboarding.ownerHint: Get ready so people looking for housing can find and book you.
onboarding.ownerStepProfile: Complete owner profile and verify ID
onboarding.ownerStepId: Wait for admin approval if needed
onboarding.ownerStepListing: Add a listing with clear photos
